short_blurb: Kitchen & bath remodels, room additions, and new construction in Downey.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Downey. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Downey, including North Downey, Northeast Downey, Rancho Estates, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Downey?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Downey building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Downey?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Downey rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Downey remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
